description: What @cancore/client/realtime expects from the gateway's Socket.IO feed. Every entry is read off the backend, and `source` says where — `Cancore-io/backend` at the commit below. A change there that this file does not follow is what realtime.contract.test.ts is for.

auth.token: the same JWT the REST client sends; the handshake is rejected without it

join.protocol: none — the server joins the socket to `user_<userId>` itself once the token verifies

events.name: order:updated
events.audience: every connected client — `server.emit`, not a room, so the client filters by order id

payload.shape: OrderResponseDto, passed through publicOrderView, which drops initiator.ethAddress / initiator.tronAddress and the same two on opponent
